note: Questions added for a carried-over draft. {title} is replaced with the draft's title.

templates.text: Which part of the draft "{title}" sounds least like you, and how would you say it instead?
What real example from your own work or life would make "{title}" more convincing?
What would a reader of "{title}" expect to find that isn't there yet?
Is there anything in "{title}" you disagree with or wouldn't say?
What is one sentence or section of "{title}" you would cut?
Who exactly should read "{title}", and does the draft speak to them?
